### 🔁 The room keeps playing after a match
- When a PvP match ends, the end screen now offers three map + mode tiles and a short clock. When it runs out, the room loads the winner and plays on — nobody has to go back to the menu.
- The vote covers the settings too: economy, match length, time of day and weather. Anything nobody voted on stays the way the room already had it.
- You can see who voted for what, and change your vote while the clock runs. Impatient rooms can start the next match immediately.
- Even if nobody touches the vote, the room rotates on its own.
- Late arrivals can join again at the end screen instead of waiting out the whole session — they walk into the vote and are playing a minute later.

### 📐 Editors snap to a grid
- Moving, resizing and rotating in the map and structure editor now snaps to a grid, so walls actually meet in game instead of only looking aligned from the editor camera.
- The grid step (and a separate rotation step) is picked in the toolbar and remembered between sessions, with the lattice drawn under whatever you are working on.
- `Round` tidies a whole map at once — useful for anything authored before the grid existed or dropped in by a preset.
